assumptions.text: Counterparty is more sensitive to timeline than to price.
Exclusivity is a bargaining anchor rather than a strict requirement.
A brief delay will not materially reduce trust or momentum.

reasoning_summary: Zeo generated a conservative branch map emphasizing plausible counterparty responses. Recommendations prioritize robustness: actions that retain value across uncertain assumptions. Uncertainty is represented as probability ranges and explicit dependencies.

flip_distance_summary.boundary: Obtain evidence moving confidence to low or contradicting the assumption. This assumption has medium confidence without a probability interval. Gathering direct evidence for or against it is the primary way to test whether the action set changes.
